summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding inconsistencies in the Campaign APIs, specifically concerning how the returned data changes based on the number of frames available. The API endpoints `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` and `/api/campaigns/target/audience` behave differently: when few frames are present (e.g., during initial filtering), the response is normal; however, when more frames are added, the request returns different data, sometimes including `null`. It was noted that significant rework will be required to improve the performance of these APIs. The issue seems related to how filters affect the volume of available frame data.
decisions: The API endpoints for campaign targeting show inconsistent behavior based on the number of frames.
action_items: Someone will review and address the inconsistencies in the Campaign APIs, particularly regarding filter changes affecting frame count.
